66750: Cortech Endurance X-Base Molded Table with Square Top
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-66750-endurance-square-top-table-w-x-base
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/tables/x-base-tables/the-endurance-42-square-top-table/
Spec sheets: 66750, Assembly
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance X-Base Molded Table with Square Top – 66750
Current H1: Cortech Endurance Square Top Table with X-Base - Molded Base and Molded Top - Model 66750
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded 42” Square Table with X-Base for Dining Rooms and Dayrooms
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 66750 Endurance 42" Square Table with X-Base
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance X-Base Molded Table with Square Top is a fully molded 42” square table for dining rooms, dayrooms, and activity rooms in correctional and behavioral healthcare facilities. The top and the x-shaped base are rotationally molded from high impact “no break” polyethylene, and the rounded edge of the top adds safety and comfort.
The legs attach to the top with tamper-resistant screws. The table can be bolted to the floor through concealed pilot holes with the Cortech Sabre Mount System, or the legs can be filled with sand to weigh it down. It comes with a plain top or a game top, and it is rated for outdoor use.
Material: Top and base rotationally molded from high impact “no break” polyethylene with an antimicrobial compound
Base: Molded x-shaped base; the legs attach to the top with tamper-resistant screws
Top Size: 42”×42” square, with a rounded edge
Dimensions: 42”W×42”D×29”H
Weight: 59 lbs (top 27 lbs, base 32 lbs)
Game Top: Optional game top with a checkerboard pattern
Outdoor Use: Rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
66750 – 42” Square, Plain Top: 59 lbs
66750GT – 42” Square, Game Top: 59 lbs
Installation and Options
Floor Mounting: Bolt to the floor through concealed pilot holes with the Sabre Mount System
Ballast: The legs can be filled with sand to weigh the table down
Assembly: The two leg pieces slide together and attach to the top with tamper-resistant screws (T40 bit); see Cortech instructions
[H2] Applications
The Endurance X-Base Molded Table suits dining rooms, dayrooms, and activity rooms where a table has to stand up to hard daily use and frequent cleaning.
Typical applications include:
Dining rooms and dayrooms in correctional facilities and jails
Behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Residential treatment centers and activity rooms
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (58 characters): Cortech Endurance X-Base Square Table - 66750 at Anchortex
Meta description (146 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance X-Base molded table with square top. A fully molded 42 inch square table with plain or game top, rated for outdoor use.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: I shortened your current H1 so it reads the same way as the round table page, with the model number at the end.
Variant names: your variants say "Solid Top." The Cortech spec sheet says "Plain Top," the same as on the Norix table pages. Would you like them renamed, for example "66750 - 42x42 Plain Top"?
Weight: your variants are set to 65 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 59 lbs (top 27 lbs, base 32 lbs), so I used 59 lbs for both.
Colors: your current page lists 12 colors. Cortech now lists 18, adding Canvas, Claylight, Moss, Overcast, Seagrass, and Tide. I used the Cortech list.
Warranty: your current page does not list a warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime warranty, so I added it.
Antimicrobial: your current page says "Infused with Cor-X antimicrobial compound." The Cortech spec sheet has a "Now infused with Cor-X antimicrobial compound" badge but does not say more, so I wrote "with an antimicrobial compound" in the Material bullet.
Outdoor use: the FAQ on the Cortech product page says fully molded tables are rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized, so I added it to the description.
Product images: the page has one image. Cortech has a photo of X-base tables in use in a library. Would you like me to add it?
